svg.title: From a request to a checked result
svg.desc: Research and compare before choosing a route; keep decisions and results visible All text and relationships stay visible. Motion demonstrates inputs, progress and retained outputs. The complete diagram remains readable with animation off or reduced motion. Live supports inspection and review. The current AI host executes tasks and returns actual results.
